Usage reads the query log (one JSON line per search, show, tree and
related: when, which agent from AGENT_NAME, the command, query and flags,
the top five paths, the time taken and the configuration's fingerprint),
and counts the calls by agent and command and by day, with each
command's median and 90th percentile time. The log is
~/.local/share/gomuxai/index-queries.jsonl ($XDG_DATA_HOME), or [log].path
in the index configuration; [log].enabled = false stops it.

Usage:
  agent index usage [flags]

Examples:
  agent index usage
  agent index usage --since 2026-11-24 --json

Flags:
      --config string   The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
  -h, --help            help for usage
      --json            Print the counts as JSON
      --since string    Only calls at or after this time (UTC, RFC 3339 or a prefix: 2026-11-24)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
